THIS BAIL APPLICATION HAVING COME UP FOR ADMISSION ON 17.11.2023, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 BAIL APPL. NO. 9080 OF 2023  2  ORDER
This is an application for anticipatory bail.

2. The petitioner is the 3rd accused in Crime No.1379 of 2021 of Punnapra Police Station, Alappuzha District, which has been registered alleging commission of offences under Sections 406, 419, 420 and 465 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

The allegation against the petitioner and the Safar vs The Station House Officer on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41531501/
1 other accused is that the 1st accused misused the Aadhaar Card of the de-facto complainant for obtaining a SIM card and handed over the said SIM card to the 2 nd accused in the case, who in turn handed it over to the petitioner and the petitioner had handed it over to one of the accused in Crime No.897 of 2021 registered at the Alappuzha South Police Station.

sentences.text: 3. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner is absolutely innocent in the matter.

It is submitted that even if all the allegations against the petitioner are accepted to be true, the only allegation against the petitioner is that he had handed over a SIM card obtained from the 2 nd accused to the accused in another case.
It is submitted that in such circumstances, the petitioner may be granted anticipatory bail.
4. The learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposes the BAIL APPL. NO. 9080 OF 2023 grant of bail.
It is submitted that Crime No.897 of 2021 of Alappuzha South Police Station is a case relating to the gruesome murder of a lawyer of the Alappuzha Bar by his political opponents.
It is submitted that some of the accused in that case are yet to be apprehend and they have absconded.

It is submitted that the allegation is that using the Aadhaar Card and other details of a third person,
certain SIM cards were obtained and this was clearly for the purpose of using the said SIM card during commission of offences.
It is submitted that the petitioner is also accused of similar offence in another case, where he has been granted anticipatory bail.
It is submitted that the allegations against the petitioner are serious and therefore, the petitioner is not entitled to anticipatory bail.

5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor and considering the fact that the allegations against the petitioner are as noticed above, I am of the view that the petitioner can be granted anticipatory bail subject to strict conditions.

The allegations against the petitioner is that he obtained a SIM card, which was obtained by the 1 st accused misusing the Aadhaar Card of the de-facto complainant and thereafter, the petitioner handed over the said SIM card to an accused in Crime No.897 of 2021 of Alappuzha South Police Station.

The allegations BAIL APPL. NO. 9080 OF 2023 against the petitioner are no doubt serious as prima facie it appears evident that the petitioner was clearly aware that he was handing over a SIM card to the third person knowing fully well that the same would be used for the commission of offence.
However, considering the nature of the allegations, I am of the opinion that the custodial interrogation of the petitioner may not be necessary.

(ii) Petitioner shall appear before the investigating officer in Crime No.1379 of 2021 of Punnapra Police Station, Alappuzha District, at 11.00 A.M on 22.11.2023 and 23.11.2023 and thereafter,

(iii) The petitioner shall not attempt to contact the de-facto complainant or interfere with the investigation or to influence or intimidate any witness in Crime No.1379 of 2021 of BAIL APPL. NO.
9080 OF 2023 Punnapra Police Station, Alappuzha District;
(iv) The petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.
(v) The petitioner shall not commit similar offence in future.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the investigating officer in Crime No.1379 of 2021 of Punnapra Police Station, Alappuzha District, may file an application before the jurisdictional Court, for cancellation of bail.
